crossRefs.note: They mourned, wept, and fasted until evening, for Saul, and for Jonathan his son, and for the people of Yahweh, and for…
when someone told me, ‘Behold, Saul is dead,’ thinking that he brought good news, I seized him and killed him in…
How much more, when wicked men have slain a righteous person in his own house on his bed, should I not now require his…
When king David came to Bahurim, behold, a man of the family of Saul’s house came out, whose name was Shimei, the son…
But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth. I afflicted my soul with fasting. My prayer returned…
I behaved myself as though it had been my friend or my brother. I bowed down mourning, as one who mourns his mother.
Don’t let them say in their heart, “Aha! That’s the way we want it!” Don’t let them say, “We have swallowed him up!”
Let them be disappointed and confounded together who rejoice at my calamity. Let them be clothed with shame and…
Whoever mocks the poor reproaches his Maker. He who is glad at calamity shall not be unpunished.
Don’t rejoice when your enemy falls. Don’t let your heart be glad when he is overthrown,
lest Yahweh see it, and it displease him, and he turn away his wrath from him.
